text_block_list.text:
After our outing,
Special Week and I returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Thank you very much for today as well, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I feel like I've gotten quite used
to going out together like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are so many more places I want to go with you, Trainer!
For example...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it! Like an amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if Trainer-san was fine
with thrill rides or haunted houses, and then I really wanted to go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I'm not good with scary things,
but the thrilling chill is kind of addictive, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Ah, but pushing from behind inside the haunted house is strictly forbidden, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Mountain climbing?!
I hadn't thought of that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It feels like this will train all sorts of things,
like lower-body strength and mental fortitude...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! How about we eat our lunch
on the mountain while enjoying the view?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Leave the bento to me! Despite how I look,
I'm actually quite good at octopus sausages, fufu!
